_readme: UI-chrome dictionary for the white-label manual template — header/footer text, nav menu labels, and print labels. It does NOT hold page content (titles/paragraphs): those live directly in each pages/**/*.html file as plain HTML, so a non-technical editor only ever needs to open an HTML file to change what a page says. It also does NOT hold language-independent manual facts like the document version — see manual-config.json for those. Only edit this JSON to rename an entry in the menu/sidebar, or to change header/footer/button wording. Keep en.json, pt.json, and es.json with the exact same set of keys.
